response.justification: Bogdan is a talented, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with strong open-source and mentoring credentials, but his career has centered on web/product development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than C++ or large-scale cloud compute infrastructure. He does not meet the core minimum qualifications of 8 years of C++ experience or 5 years building large-scale distributed/compute infrastructure, making him a poor match for this specific technical-lead role.
strengths: Deep, varied technical breadth across web, mobile, embedded, and systems programming
Strong mentoring, workshop, and public-speaking track record
Demonstrated ownership of complex projects (open-source GIS platform, low-latency microservices)
concerns: No substantial C++ experience (only brief NI role ~6 months), far short of 8-year requirement
Lacks demonstrated large-scale cloud compute/distributed infrastructure leadership
Career trajectory is broad generalist/full-stack rather than focused cloud platform architecture

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud compute infrastructure experience
Strong leadership, mentoring, and software craftsmanship background
